primary_gap: Does the current init+contrast package change class-log-odds graph-evidence response shape beyond scaling and improve the declared pool over init and capable single/independent/packed-untied controls?
theoretical_findings: For a single fixed-P linear chain, propagation is P^L X B_m and cannot restore kernel-erased evidence. Residual/root branches can mix P^k with member coefficients and preserve raw information, so even linear residual GNNs can differ in hop/root reliance.
Private node-dependent nonlinear gates and recomputed private attention can change neighbor/evidence sensitivity; signed-factor ReLU representability witness provided.
Class-centering plus cosine contrast is neither conditional mutual information nor a label-information certificate.
A differentiable shared W receives all relevant member/auxiliary gradients; own losses do not independently train W.
